title: AdFin: Two Southern Trust Wires, 1,428,571 Series A Shares
scope: BANK-5 reconstruction of Southern Trust Company's two funded 2013 AdFin Solutions Series A subsequent closings and resulting preferred-share ownership.

sources.supports: Executed Series A SPA; $0.4375/share; April and July subsequent-closing purchaser schedules; Southern Trust 1,142,857 + 285,714 shares; scheduled prices $499,999.94 + $124,999.87.
sources.limit: Does not by itself prove bank settlement; bank records below do.

sources.supports: Apr. 10, 2013 Southern Trust $500,000 transfer to AdFin; payment details state subscription for Series A Preferred.
sources.limit: Nominal bank amount differs by $0.06 from scheduled legal purchase price.

sources.supports: Jul. 15, 2013 Southern Trust $125,000 Fedwire debit to AdFin for Series A preferred subscription.
sources.limit: Bank posting date precedes Jul. 23 legal subsequent-closing date.

sources.supports: Groff tracks missing Southern Trust stock certificate for 1,142,857 April Series A shares.
sources.limit: Certificate image itself is not OCR-recovered; ownership also appears in executed SPA.

sources.supports: Jan. 2013 Mitchell request to meet Epstein on AdFin and CEO; Epstein approves scheduling.
Two-closing reconciliation, ownership totals, investor-role separation, product classification, negative-control searches and BANK-5 classification.
sources.limit: Archive-created synthesis; controlling ownership and cash claims remain tied to primary records.
